```json
{"bugs_found": ["Parser.until: condition `if res.status or times >= min` returns success whenever times>=min regardless of whether other actually matched, violating the contract 'other success is accepted only when times >= min'. With min=0 it returns Result.success(index, []) immediately on first iteration without ever running self, and with consume_other=True it appends res.value (None on failure) and sets index to res.index (-1 on failure). The correct condition is `if res.status and times >= min`."], "verdict": "REQUEST_CHANGES"}
```
